content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Accept and Transfer Conversations ## slug: accept-and-transfer-conversations ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End You now have the ability to Accept or Transfer conversations within Blackthorn Messaging. Accepting a conversation means assigning ownership of that conversation to yourself. While Transferring a conversation means assigning ownership of that conversation to another user or queue.
